title: The event reminders (a week out, 24h, 2h) and the dispatch notice escape member-written text in their HTML part

source.ref: Production to Frequency handoff 2026-10-14, section 9: user text in emails gets escaped (event reminders and post emails). Checked against main at eb26a01.

detail: eventReminderHtml (the 24h and 2h reminder) printed the event title, the recipient's name, the when line and the location into the HTML unescaped; dispatchHtml printed the author, the dispatch title, the excerpt and the recipient's name unescaped; and the cron's own week-ahead email (app/api/cron/event-reminders/route.ts) did the same for the title, name, when, location and proof line. An event titled with markup rendered as live HTML, a link included, in every attendee's inbox. Each value now goes through lib/email.ts's escapeHtml, exported for the cron. The plain-text parts are unchanged. lib/email.test.ts pins both senders with a markup title.
